confirmed_decisions.timestamp: unsigned64 1MHz; STOP/clear fault/DMA reset preserve; PL reconfiguration new epoch
confirmed_decisions.stop: finish current pulse timing, cancel session
confirmed_decisions.position: invalid on power-up; HOME or explicit maintenance REBASE; no automatic EN recovery
confirmed_decisions.dma_first: Anlogic AXI DMA HP0 64-bit stream simple mode; one record per packet; Linux DMAengine validation
confirmed_decisions.step_dir: STEP rising edge counted, idle low; DIR=1 positive; EN polarity explicit parameter
confirmed_decisions.safety_edge_priority: STOP/underflow/fault inhibit new same-cycle edge; retain already emitted count
confirmed_decisions.maintenance_rebase: EN disabled, idle, no session or pending command; load signed64 and set valid; HOME uses same commit; DISABLE invalidates
confirmed_decisions.single_axis_stop_enable: finish high/low and DIR hold; cancel session; retain EN for STOP/underflow/ordinary fault; DISABLE releases after safe stop and explicit delay
confirmed_decisions.single_axis_reset_clear: reset immediately idles STEP/disables EN/invalidates position and may truncate pulse; clear fault never restores session or EN; explicit new session required
confirmed_decisions.four_axis_scheduler: common Nmax=max(abs(delta_i)) slots; integer remainder emits exactly Ni; all nonzero axes emit in first slot
confirmed_decisions.four_axis_correspondence: actual rising edges in the same slot are corresponding; same-clock PL logical outputs in this phase; driver inputs require later measurement
confirmed_decisions.four_axis_feasibility: checked duration_tick*100; common conservative DIR/EN/low guard; whole group validated before output; final high/low/hold within duration; any infeasible axis rejects and cancels whole session
confirmed_decisions.four_axis_phase_scope: atomic single point with exact duration and common stop; normal point completion retains session; explicit upstream underflow; continuous FIFO/normal END/pause deferred
confirmed_decisions.continuous_end: END final point completes full duration/pulse safety; close session, retain EN/actual position; no underflow; reject further same-session points after END accepted
confirmed_decisions.continuous_pause: PAUSE at current point boundary including same-cycle request; retain FIFO/prefetch/session/EN; explicit RESUME from next relative interval; exclude paused wall time; STOP/fault > END completion > PAUSE
confirmed_decisions.continuous_sequence: logical u32 from 0 strictly contiguous without wrap; duplicate/gap/order/post-END cancels current session; old session handshake discarded with stale, isolated from current session; OPEN idle/flushed with new nonzero globally unique upstream ID
confirmed_decisions.continuous_start: first point prechecked plus explicit START_MIN_POINTS and config/position/EN safety; complete cached END allows short trajectory below threshold
confirmed_decisions.continuous_underflow: boundary without prechecked next point cancels and flushes FIFO/all prefetch/prediction; same-cycle late point cannot rescue; STOP/fault/reset likewise flush; retain emitted count except reset zero/invalid; never restore old session
confirmed_decisions.continuous_scope: additive logical record interface; wire layout/CRC/product capacity/driver timing remain draft or explicit parameters; no AXI/DMA/BSP/hardware integration
confirmed_decisions.gp_control_profile: gp_control_probe_v1; logic/resource choices confirmed, implementation and HPF/DTS/board verification pending; all other GP entries remain draft

clock_reset.clock_domains: one shared GP/control domain; no custom asynchronous GP-to-control CDC
clock_reset.init_complete: common synchronized reset released; enter NOT_READY and start timestamp at zero

transaction.submit_capture: all shadows captured atomically on paired SUBMIT
transaction.axi_okay: submission only, not operation or motion completion
transaction.completion: ACK_VALID and matching ACK_ID and COMPLETED; only NOP/snapshot operation
transaction.id: nonzero u32 strictly increasing, gaps allowed, no wrap
transaction.new_legal_id: consume and update LAST_TXN_ID even for BAD_COMMAND; cache result
transaction.duplicate_same_payload: reuse most recent cached result; no resampling; reassert ACK pending
transaction.on_new_submit: clear old ACK_VALID and set BUSY
transaction.on_publish: clear BUSY, set ACK_VALID, emit ACK event
transaction.reset_priority: cancel in-flight; no old ACK/snapshot publication
transaction.id_exhaustion: stop submission; controlled whole-domain new epoch required
transaction.driver_rebind: read LAST_TXN_ID before choosing next ID; consume old result before new submission

snapshot.sampling: one shared rising edge, pre-edge registered actual state
snapshot.same_edge_step_update: visible only to a later snapshot
snapshot.publication: whole frame, SNAP_ID=TXN_ID and SNAP_VALID=1 same cycle; success ACK no earlier
snapshot.hold: until next successful new SNAPSHOT; duplicate/failed commands, NOP, reads and IRQ clear preserve
snapshot.reset: SNAP_VALID=0; frame zero except no-point sequence overrides
snapshot.software_read: serial request; ID/VALID, all LO/HI, ID/VALID; discard if invalid or changed
snapshot.old_frame_during_busy: readable but not completion for new ID
snapshot.position_source: emitted STEP command position; never planner endpoint or encoder feedback

other global registers/errors/states and command semantics
gp_control_probe_v1.migration: additive profile and four registers/NOP/TEST bit in unused slots; existing draft addresses/commands unchanged; regenerate shared headers from schema; check FEATURES before enabling functionality; future motion/CDC changes require review

dma_loopback_v1.packet: One MM2S simple transfer per packet; post equal-length S2MM first; preserve data/keep/last/user/id/dest; no motion record layout is frozen.
dma_loopback_v1.reset: Common p2f_rst0_n boot reset only; async assertion/two-stage release. Any primary channel reset flushes loop FIFO; release only after both channels recover. BSP blocks submissions, terminates synchronously and resets both directions before new generation; it must establish DDR quiescence before buffer reuse. DMA-only recovery preserves GP time/ABI.
dma_loopback_v1.hardware_guard: Full aligned word writes; BTT must be 1..65535; addresses 8-byte aligned; nonzero address MSB writes rejected with SLVERR before IP.

gp_motion_v1.transport_error_scope: HP MM2S non-OKAY RRESP and primary reset are observed in hardware; other internal DMA errors require BSP IRQ handler GP STOP

constraints.ids: nonzero monotonic no wrap; latest same payload idempotent
constraints.local_reset: RUN=0, collector idle and cfg_ready, no bridge config pending; system time preserved
constraints.metadata: revision at enqueue, generation at capture; collector FIFO reset on local reset
constraints.snapshot: same edge registered values; no sequential sampling
constraints.deployment: candidate resources; final BSP HPF/DT/IRQ audit required; not integrated

semantics.rx: freeze exact N*64 then RX descriptor before ARM; no short residue assumption
semantics.cache: local collector reset invalidates; DMA reset preserves
